versions.content: If (EndToEndTransformationDescription.upperHeaderBitsTo Shift > 0), out-of-place E2EXf_<transformerId> shall copy the first upper HeaderBits ToShiftbits from inputBuffer to buffer, and then copy the remaining part of inputBuffer (i.e. starting with offset upperHeaderBitsToShift) to parameter buffer starting with the destination offset of (upperHeaderBitsToShift+ BufferProperties.headerLength).
